findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler is abstract but implements nothing
findings.body: In src/sentry/incidents/grouptype.py line 11, MetricAlertDetectorHandler now subclasses StatefulDetectorHandler with only `pass`. StatefulDetectorHandler has abstract members counter_names, get_dedupe_value, get_group_key_values, and build_occurrence_and_event_data. A subclass that does not implement them cannot be instantiated - Python raises TypeError: Can't instantiate abstract class. If a Detector with type metric_alert_fire is processed, Detector.detector_handler tries to instantiate this handler and will raise instead of returning None, crashing process_detectors for the whole batch.

findings.title: get_state_data crashes when counter_names is empty
findings.body: In src/sentry/workflow_engine/processors/detector.py line 222, get_state_data does `counter_updates=counter_updates[gk]`. When self.counter_names is empty/falsy, the code skips the Redis fetch and leaves counter_updates as {}. The later indexing then raises KeyError for every group_key. The `if self.counter_names:` guard shows empty list is intended to be valid for detectors that track no counters, but such detectors will crash on every evaluate call instead of getting empty/default counters.

findings.title: Multi-group test uses wrong value and helper ignores value
findings.body: In tests/sentry/workflow_engine/processors/test_detector.py line 191, test_state_results_multi_group creates a DataPacket with group_vals {"group_1": 6, "group_2": 10} but builds the expected occurrence for group_2 with value 6. The helper build_mock_occurrence_and_event never uses the `value` argument to build the IssueOccurrence, so the test passes despite the mismatch. As a result the test does not verify that evaluate forwards the correct per-group value to build_occurrence_and_event_data, masking bugs where the wrong value is used.

findings.title: Docstring still says returns list after changing to dict
findings.body: In src/sentry/workflow_engine/processors/detector.py line 230, StatefulDetectorHandler.evaluate docstring says "returns a list of DetectorEvaluationResult" but the PR changed the signature to return dict[DetectorGroupKey, DetectorEvaluationResult]. The stale docstring misleads implementers and callers about the contract.
